newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Asked about the Commission's position on the outburst of violence in the Palestinian territories, spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo said the European Union would maintain its aid to the Palestinians and that the General Affairs Council would discuss supplementary aid in order to consoldiate the peace process.

He said the Council would also look at an agreeement with Palestine in the framework of the Euro-Mediterranean cooperation and might speak about the human right clause in the bilateral agreement between the EU and Israel.
The Commission released the following documents:

- IP/96/860: Commission hails the start of the proceedings at the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda and welcomes the decision of UNHCR to lift the refugee status of a number of indicted persons.
- IP/96/862: The Commission launches the fourth European young consumer competition.
- IP/96/863: Ritt Bjerregaard: Stricter standards for the medical use of X-rays and radioisotopes.
- Speech/96/224: Message from Commissioner Papoutsis on the occasion of world tourism day.
- Speech/96/225: Statement by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy at the Kangeroo conference.
- Speech/96/226: Statement by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy to the interim Commitee of the IMF.
- Speech/96/227: Extracts from Commissioner Monti's speech at the General Assembly of the New European Biotechnology Association.
- Eurostat news release No 62/96: Higher spending as costs and expectations grow.
- Eurostat, Statistics in focus, population and social conditions No 1996-4: Statistical data on health care systems in the European Union (1980-1993).
- Memo/96/91: Calendar of the week of September 30 to October 5, 1996.
